messages:
anne (PM): Heads-up — a few customers asked for a "strict schema" mode that rejects non-conforming outputs and returns structured validation errors instead of fuzzy retries. want to discuss tradeoffs.

dena (eng): +1. important to clarify failure semantics: do we 1) fail-fast with error payload, 2) attempt automated repair + retry, or 3) fall back to a soft-validated result with confidence metadata?

mike (infra): perf note: aggressive retrying increases token cost and latency, and impacts routing/backpressure for Dedicated pools. we need SLO bounds for each option.

saul (ml): customers fall into two buckets: strict compliance (fin/regtech) vs UX-first apps that prefer graceful degradation. we should support both but with clear defaults.

jess (solutions): Example ask from KYC customer: they want server-side enforcement so any non-JSON triggers a 4xx-like response and a human-review ticket. They can't accept repaired heuristics.

anne (PM): OK — propose two modes: "enforce" (hard reject + structured error) and "repair" (attempt up to N retries with sanitizer heuristics). Default = repair. Thoughts on API surface?

dena (eng): API idea: add param validate_schema=true/false and validate_mode={enforce,repair,annotate}. response contains `validation` block when enabled. e.g.:
```json
{"output":"{...}","validation":{"ok":false,"errors":[{"path":"/address/zip","msg":"expected string of 5 digits"}],"attempts":1}}
```

mike (infra): If we expose attempts/retry_count we should also surface cost estimate in response header or token accounting so billing is clear. otherwise ops will get support tickets.

saul (ml): Repair strategies: small canonical fixes (unescape, close braces), schema-aware slot injection, or rerank candidate completions against schema. rerank can be expensive but higher success. we should gate rerank to Dedicated or higher tiers.

jess (solutions): Also need an out-of-band human review hook: when enforce mode returns error, create a review ticket via integrations (ticketing webhooks) with the failed payload + diff + suggested fixes.

anne (PM): Launch criteria brainstorm: 1) spec for validate_mode + error schema, 2) server-side audit events + webhook for review, 3) cost signal per attempt, 4) bounded latency behavior documented (p50/p95 for repair vs enforce), 5) e2e tests with canonical eval suites.

dena (eng): Implementation plan: phase 1 = annotate + enforce (no auto-repair) — cheapest to ship. phase 2 = repair heuristics (sync retries, low token budget). phase 3 = rerank + model-backed repair (async or Dedicated only).

mike (infra): For phase1 we can implement a fast local validator (JSON Schema v7 subset) that runs pre-return. will add a feature flag so Private customers can opt-in to local-only paths for compliance.

saul (ml): Eval data: we can reuse existing structured-output evals, but need a separate dataset for edge cases (malformed escapes, mixed plain text + JSON, partial outputs). we should measure both precision (valid outputs) and gold agreement.

jess (solutions): Pricing ask from sales: they want a per-validation-unit surcharge or an "attempts" billing line. I'd prefer attempts-based discounts for high-volume customers.

anne (PM): Decision needed today: ship annotate+enforce as default roadmap item, push repair/rerank to subsequent sprints and gate rerank on Dedicated SLA. any objections?

dena (eng): no objections. annotate+enforce makes docs + SDK changes straightforward.

mike (infra): agree. will draft perf targets for enforce (no extra tokens) and annotate (small CPU overhead).

saul (ml): i'll prototype a lightweight rerank scoring that uses schema match percentage + LM fluency to pick candidates. share results next week.

jess (solutions): I'll sync with the KYC contact to confirm review webhook details and get sample policy language.

anne (PM): Next steps: dena write API spec PR (validate_mode + validation block), mike add cost header proposal, saul run rerank prototype, jess collect customer integration requirements. I'll create the EPIC and assign stories. thanks :rocket:

oncall-bot: dena (eng) added 2 files to the spec-branch: /specs/structured-validation.md and /specs/validation-error-schema.json

anne (PM): filing follow-up: decide default config for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (probably repair off by default for Hosted, repair opt-in for Private/Dedicated). we'll reconvene after PR reviews.
